extracted.name: Southern-fried chicken tacos
extracted.description: Make our southern-fried chicken tacos for a budget family dinner that you can prep in just 10 minutes with a handful of ingredients
ingredient_lines: 2 x 305g packs southern fried chicken goujons
8 small soft corn tortillas or 12 mini flour tortillas
3 Little Gem lettuces cut into wedges
instruction_lines: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/ gas 6. Put the chicken on a baking sheet and cook for 15 mins or until piping hot in the centre. Meanwhile, stir half the chives into the soured cream and season to taste.

Warm the tortillas in the microwave on high for about 1 min. Slice each chicken piece in half diagonally. Serve the warm tortillas topped with the chicken, lettuce wedges, a dollop of soured cream, the spring onions and a generous glug of buffalo sauce. Scatter over the remaining chives to serve.
